id: title:gewenyu99:add flutter and kmp to wizard skill ids

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Flutter and KMP support to the onboarding wizard, allowing users to select these skills and proceed with relevant SDK installation.
review.reason: The supplied observations indicate a localized, bounded change: P1.F1.H1 adds Flutter and KMP to the supported skill identifiers, and P1.F1.H2 adds their SDK key mappings. This results in Flutter and KMP becoming selectable options and installable SDKs within the onboarding flow. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement. No systemic risk reduction or broader capability
